title: 周长固定矩形内的可变半径圆
titleEn: Variable-radius circles in a fixed-perimeter rectangle

knownBest.source: Computer-assisted proof submitted by zzzcy #308 (generated with AI assistance, as stated): a complete interval branch-and-exclude over every contact order of the n circles leaves one contact structure, fixed by interval Newton, which gives the continuous optimum; the largest nine-decimal sum of radii is 0.813965438, the current record, by a complete branch tree over integer offsets. MinMax Arena replayed every certificate with its own code without running the submitted scripts.
